title: Middle East Tensions Escalate with Focus on Israel and Iran
summary: Tensions in the Middle East are ongoing, with significant focus on developments involving Israel and Iran. Coverage includes live updates on the situation in Israel, Iran, and the broader Middle East region, as well as news concerning the Israel-Gaza conflict and Lebanon.
title_hi: मध्य पूर्व में इजराइल और ईरान पर केंद्रित तनाव बढ़ा
